title: Hologram Effect Shader with Scanlines
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that renders a hologram effect shader with animated scanlines on a 3D object. Requirements:

1. SCENE SETUP:
- Dark background (0x050510)
- PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 1.5, 4) looking at origin
- A TorusKnot geometry (radius 1, tube 0.35, tubularSegments 128, radialSegments 32) as the hologram subject
- A flat grid plane (GridHelper, size 6, divisions 20, color 0x00ffcc alpha 0.2) at y=-1.5
- Ambient light (0x003344, intensity 0.3)
- No post-processing; all effects via custom ShaderMaterial

2. HOLOGRAM SHADER:
- Custom vertex shader: pass vPosition (model-space), vNormal, vWorldPosition to fragment
- Fragment shader implements:
  a) Base hologram color: vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.8) (cyan-green)
  b) Fresnel rim glow: pow(1.0 - abs(dot(viewDir, normal)), fresnelPower) where fresnelPower is a uniform (default 2.5)
  c) Scanlines: sin(vWorldPosition.y * scanlineFrequency + time * scanlineSpeed) pattern. scanlineFrequency uniform default 30.0, scanlineSpeed uniform default 2.0
  d) Scanline intensity controlled by uniform scanlineIntensity (default 0.4). Final alpha modulated by scanline pattern
  e) Flicker effect: random per-frame subtle opacity variation (amplitude 0.05)
  f) Glitch offset: vertex displacement in x by glitchAmount uniform (default 0.0), applied when glitch is active
- Material: transparent, side DoubleSide, depthWrite false, blending AdditiveBlending

3. USER INTERACTIONS:
- Keyboard 'G': Toggle glitch mode (sets glitchAmount to 0.15 when active, 0.0 when inactive)
- Keyboard 'S': Cycle scanline density through 3 presets: LOW (15.0), MEDIUM (30.0), HIGH (60.0)
- Keyboard 'F': Cycle fresnel power through: 1.5, 2.5, 4.0
- Keyboard 'R': Toggle rotation of the torus knot (default: rotating at 0.5 rad/s around Y)
- Keyboard 'C': Cycle hologram color through: cyan (0,1,0.8), magenta (1,0,0.8), gold (1,0.85,0)
- Mouse wheel: Adjust scanlineSpeed (clamp between 0.5 and 8.0, step 0.5)
- DOM button '#btn-reset': Reset all parameters to defaults

4. HUD/UI:
- Top-left overlay div showing current state:
  - Scanline Density: LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH
  - Fresnel Power: value
  - Glitch: ON/OFF
  - Rotation: ON/OFF
  - Color: CYAN/MAGENTA/GOLD
  - Scanline Speed: value
- A 'Reset' button with id='btn-reset' at bottom-center

5. STATE MANAGEMENT - expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- glitchActive: boolean
- glitchAmount: number (current uniform value)
- scanlineDensity: string ('LOW'|'MEDIUM'|'HIGH')
- scanlineFrequency: number (current uniform value)
- scanlineSpeed: number (current uniform value)
- fresnelPower: number (current uniform value)
- rotationEnabled: boolean
- rotationAngle: number (current Y rotation in radians)
- colorName: string ('CYAN'|'MAGENTA'|'GOLD')
- colorRGB: array [r, g, b] (float values)
- elapsedTime: number (shader time uniform)
- meshExists: boolean
- shaderCompiled: boolean (set true after first render)
- flickerValue: number (current flicker multiplier, ~0.95-1.05)

6. ANIMATION:
- Use requestAnimationFrame loop
- Update time uniform each frame
- Rotate torus knot around Y axis when rotation enabled
- Update flickerValue each frame
- Update window.__3D_STATE__ every frame before render
physics_constraints: Scanline speed must be clamped [0.5, 8.0]. Fresnel power cycles exactly through [1.5, 2.5, 4.0]. Glitch displacement is exactly 0.15 when active. Rotation speed is 0.5 rad/s. All uniform values must be NaN-free and finite.
